# Forwarder loader

`main` and `main.npdm` are the forwarder loader built into sphaira 1.0.8, taken
from the release's `sphaira.nro`. They go into every home screen shortcut and
load `green-nx.nro` with the shortcut's `--appid`.

Source: https://github.com/ITotalJustice/sphaira/tree/master/hbl (based on
nx-hbloader). Licences: GPL-3.0 for sphaira, ISC for nx-hbloader.
